qualified_resume_guards.four_locks: microphone_lock,motion_policy.lock,initiative.lock,durable_intent.lock wrap panel_match,quiescent/MIC/privacy checks and positive transition
exact_checks: input owner_id mustNone; actualmicrophone_owner_id andmotion_policy.owner_id mustNone
held andquiescent required; microphone permission enabled
qualified_resume_guards.scope: Detects changed issued Agent authority under these locks, not atomic PC source-epoch attestation.

ancestry_boundary.POSTpause: Empty payload. Private committed revision captured under locks, but returned pause_status(refresh=False) is collected later after locks and stop_speaker. It may reflect a later human pause/control.
ancestry_boundary.check_possible: Retain BEFORE Agentboot/revision and require response Agentboot same and pause_revision exactly before+1. Refuse mismatches; never adopt latest foreign pause.
ancestry_boundary.not_fully_qualified: Raw POST response does not expose immutable owncommit token. Complete provenance for all intervening control-generation changes is not qualified by this one boundary read.
ancestry_boundary.PC_source_epoch: No PCboot/source hash field in resume_binding/panel_match. PCboot errors are found by prior pause_status refresh outside positive four-lock section. No proof here of atomic rejection of every PC source change through positive commit.
ancestry_boundary.decision: Do not offer automatic ownresume from this source preparation.

manual_proposal.intent: Pause ALL current canonical Agent turns, allow existing canonical completion/cancellation observation, and leave paused without automatic resume.
manual_proposal.observation: Only existing canonical held GET/pause-state in original bounds; may refresh/cancel still-unreleased registered canonical turns as part of explicitly requested global pause. Record actual receipts, never relabel cached/UNKNOWN as release.
effects_disclosed: Listening/questions/current speech interrupted; capture retired and expressions held by existing negative transition.
Pending/resume audio cleared; canonical Agent turns may be cancelled.
No model input/source patch/installer/restart/motor unfold or new movement.
No automatic positive resume; caller does not restore historical settings or adopt later human pause.
receipt_fields: source/currentcontrol changes and whether observation stopped
manual_proposal.safe_refusal: Timeout, boot/source mismatch, unknown, missing release or changed controls: stop further actions and retain existing negative state. No pause retry, conditionalguard bypass, resume, UNKNOWNclear, foreign kill or restart. Latest human resume/STOP/privacy wins.
manual_proposal.success_limit: Receipt reconciliation may succeed; normal working return is NOT promised. If user does not accept remaining paused, this proposal is NO-GO.
